base_value_source: FY26 reported, consolidated EBITDA — earnings/01_historical-financials.md §1, Capital IQ export, Income Statement tab, FY2026 column; company discloses no adjusted/non-GAAP EBITDA (01_historical-financials.md §4)

sensitivities.label: Discretionary customer-acquisition opex (Advertisement + Outsourced sales cost)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Coefficient assumes 1:1 opex-to-EBITDA pass-through with zero offsetting revenue benefit (inference) — margin-drivers §9 finds the ad-spend ramp has not yet shown a proven revenue payoff. The bear-case Advertisement level (INR 1,600mn/yr = ~INR 10 crore/quarter) is management's own guided target; Outsourced-sales cost is held flat in the bear case (inferred, not company-guided).
sensitivities.source: earnings/03_margin-drivers.md §2, §8, §9 (FY26 Annual Report (Ind AS), Note 24; Q3 FY26 Earnings Call, Jan 20 2026, Q&A)

sensitivities.label: ARPU / price realization (Web segment)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Coefficient assumes revenue flow-through at FY26's own consolidated EBITDA margin (33.18%) — inference, since IndiaMART has no COGS/gross-margin line to derive a true incremental margin. Applied against the current 218,000-subscriber base held constant (see report §5 for the interaction with paying_subscriber_net_adds).

sensitivities.label: Paying-subscriber net additions (Web segment volume, annualized)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Same FY26-EBITDA-margin flow-through inference as arpu_web_segment. Ignores subscriber ramp/timing lag — a supplier added mid-year would not earn a full year of ARPU in year one, so the modelled impact is a full-year run-rate, not a same-year cash impact. Base value 0 reflects the trailing-year actual (218,000 flat, Jun-25 to Jun-26).
sensitivities.source: earnings/02_revenue-drivers.md §4 (Q2 FY26-Q1 FY27 Earnings Calls, prepared remarks — quarterly net-add actuals)

sensitivities.label: Investment-portfolio (treasury book) NAV move
sensitivities.non_linearity: Company-disclosed sensitivity covers the mutual-fund/ETF/bond/debenture treasury book only; it hits Profit Before Tax below the EBIT line, not reported EBITDA — do not add this impact to base_value (a different metric; see impact_metric).
sensitivities.source: business-model/10_external-dependency.md §2 (FY26 Annual Report (Ind AS), Note 31 — Financial risk management, Interest rate risk sensitivity table)

sensitivities.label: Customer support / trust-and-verification cost buildout (KYC, OTP, buy-lead verification, agentic call handling)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Coefficient assumes 1:1 opex-to-EBITDA pass-through (no revenue offset). This cost line has risen in every disclosed period (+116% YoY FY26, +168bps again YoY in Q1 FY27) with no observed decline — the 'bull' scenario here is a smaller increase, not an actual decrease (report §6).
